# Jeremia Axel — Personal Sites

Personal sites and apps of Jeremia Axel, a software engineer.

- [Portfolio](https://jeremiaaxel.dev/): projects, work experience, and skills.
- [Blog](https://blog.jeremiaaxel.dev/): writing on software engineering and technology. RSS feed at https://blog.jeremiaaxel.dev/rss.xml.
- [Money Backward](https://moneybackward.jeremiaaxel.dev/): expense and income tracker web app (login required).
- [Work Utilities](https://work-utils.jeremiaaxel.dev/): small public work tools, focused on Japanese reading and PDF translation.
